src/session.reason: Session lifecycle, queue and stream ownership plus the two application-context/pricing composition files and three existing host policy helpers moved from engine for #224. src/clients/tui/presentation/components/.reason: Verbatim copy of legacy source/components/message/CommandMessage.tsx: tool rows match legacy by construction; splitting it would reintroduce a rewrite to prove. Four lines are the port exception that reads a live render's measured elapsed time (live-tool-age.ts). Three more are the accepted difference that keeps a finished row's status while a decision is open (#136 item 8).
Verbatim copy of legacy source/components/message/command-message-helpers.ts, the parsers and labels CommandMessage and its renderers share.

src/clients/tui/menus/use-subagent-pool-.reason: Port of source/hooks/use-subagent-pool-selection.ts with only imports changed; kept whole so it stays diffable against the legacy oracle.

src/clients/tui/session.tsx.reason: The session wires the composer to the ported legacy menu stack (useMenuStack, double-Escape) and routes every report into the transcript as legacy's addSystemMessage does; that wiring closes over submit, rewind and the viewport, declared later in the same component, so moving it out would add ref plumbing rather than a job seam. The composer's JSX also sits inside ComposerWidth (legacy InputBox's width-0 first frame), which only wraps it, and the command path preserves each menu's composer routing. The approval panel's Escape adds legacy's Stopped line through the viewport (one prop). The menu stack's first-run setup prompt sits under the live divider as legacy BottomArea places it (one line; the gate itself lives in menus/use-first-run-setup.ts). Candidate 2 adds the ported approval prompt host and tasks panel around the hidden composer box (legacy BottomArea order), which the same routing owns. The harness composer acknowledgement waits for the input to remount after an Esc-closed menu (two lines). Issue #221 adds submit-path wiring that has to close over submit's own locals: the /compact branch and the steer-to-auto delivery rule call compactTracker in commands.ts, which owns the in-flight count and outcome notice, and the in-flight draft restore compares against the text as typed so it does not duplicate it.

src/clients/tui/approval-prompt.tsx.reason: Verbatim port of legacy source/components/prompt/ApprovalPrompt.tsx (every approval and ask_user layout and key path); only its data access changed, so it matches legacy by construction.
